title: ReconcileAI — 3-Way Supply Chain Inventory Auditor & Copilot
description: Enterprise-grade 3-Way reconciliation engine eliminating manual discrepancies between ERP Purchase Orders (PO 43), Commercial Customs Invoices (Ped 41), and Physical Dock QC counts.
long_description: ReconcileAI is a production-grade operations automation engine and audit copilot. It resolves the classic multi-tier supply chain mismatch between Parent Prepacks (PRK) and Child SKUs (UN) using deterministic heuristic curve verification (100% zero-error curve validation). Features include self-healing spreadsheet recovery for damaged official Excel models, fast-paste dual TSV strips (Cols AS:AZ) allowing operators to square official corporate closures in under 10 seconds, and 1-click generation of fully squared .xlsm workbooks with intact corporate VBA macros. Packaged as a 100% standalone portable distribution requiring zero Python runtime or administrative rights.

title: Enterprise AI CRM — Human-in-the-Loop Orchestrator
description: Compliance-first AI orchestration framework combining local LLM inference, deterministic safety guardrails, and real-time Human-in-the-Loop oversight.
long_description: Designed and built an enterprise-grade AI orchestration framework integrating Local LLMs with WhatsApp for auditable, human-supervised customer communication in regulated sectors. Employs deterministic regex and policy guardrails, dynamic intent routing, real-time WebSocket negotiation for operator approval queues, and complete observability via Prometheus metrics. Decoupled architecture with FastAPI backend and high-performance React dashboard.

title: Unity Modular Core — Spec-Driven Game Architecture
description: Constitutional Spec-Driven Development (SDD) game engine blueprint synthesizing lessons from 14 projects into pure C# domain decoupling, Service Locator, and ScriptableObject data flow.
long_description: A comprehensive game systems blueprint based on the SpecKit Spec-Driven Development methodology. Enforces strict constitutional articles: Pure C# Domain Layer with zero Unity engine dependencies for isolated unit testing, Service Locator / Inversion of Control pattern to ban manager singletons, and type-safe Event Bus communication. Bridges seamlessly into Unity 6 URP infrastructure, ScriptableObject registries, and custom editor tooling for rapid game designer iteration.

title: ELMS — Echo-Location Maze System & Sonar Shaders
description: Procedural maze generation and real-time echo-location mechanics powered by custom HLSL/ShaderLab wavefront shaders and decoupled event mechanics.
long_description: ELMS is a real-time exploration demonstration combining procedural generation with an acoustic visibility mechanic. Developed with decoupled systems and designer-centric tooling. Features a custom HLSL wavefront shader calculating real-time distance fields to reveal unseen labyrinth geometry as sound pulses propagate, alongside runtime seed management and modular player controllers.

title: NebulaView — Provider-First Content Discovery System
description: Bilingual (EN / ES-419) media discovery web application with resilient multi-provider streaming fallbacks, TMDB meta-enrichment, and Next.js / Supabase.
long_description: NebulaView is a provider-first entertainment platform built on Next.js 14 and TypeScript. Solves API instability and geo-blocking by implementing Consumet extensions with automated provider fallback. Features dynamic TMDB metadata ingestion, Redis edge caching for sub-second responses, Supabase user persistence, and fluid Framer Motion micro-interactions.

title: ResourceManager — Clean Service Architecture Toolkit
description: Modular TypeScript backend toolkit demonstrating clean service architecture, CRUD lifecycle, permission layers, and strict data validation.
long_description: A TypeScript-first backend toolkit designed to test robust patterns for modern SaaS services and web APIs. Features clean service boundaries, declarative permission models, schema-based request validation, and zero-coupling data access layers.

title: Local AI Companion — Quantized Offline Assistant Framework
description: Privacy-first modular framework running quantized local LLMs with contextual episodic memory and persona persistence.
long_description: An offline-first AI framework designed for zero-cloud environments. Manages local model inference orchestration via Python and PyTorch with 4-bit/8-bit quantization for consumer hardware. Includes long-term conversational memory graphs and desktop integration logic.

title: Custom HTML5 Video & Cinematic Controller (RPG Maker MZ)
description: Engine plugin expanding video playback for dynamic alpha layering, loop points, and interpreter-integrated interactive skips.
long_description: Developed a JavaScript plugin directly hooking into RPG Maker MZ's core interpreter to grant fine-grained cinematic control. Enables alpha-channel video blending, variable playback speeds, seamless looping, and conditional interactive event branching.
